title: That Old Feeling, after Rod Stewart

details.title: That Old Feeling
details.lead: Rod Stewart's sung line, played straight on the trumpet, an octave above where he sings it, in his key: concert D♭4 to G5 (written E♭4 to A5).
facts: That Old Feeling, as Rod Stewart sings it on the recording you sent
